parts.text: Meredith is a freelance blogger who writes about health topics and submits to clients each day as her permanent job.
A blog article takes an average of 4.5 hours to research and write about.
Last week, she wrote 5 articles on Monday and  0.4 times more articles on Tuesday than on Monday.
On Wednesday, she wrote twice the number of articles she wrote on Tuesday.
Calculate the total number of hours she spent writing articles in the three days.

parts.text: Bear is a company that currently has employed 200 people.
Jaime is a computer programmer for a company that currently has employed 100 people.
In Jaime, senior programmers are paid $400 more than junior programmers.

If the number of Junior programmers is 2/5 of the total number of Jaime's employees, and they are each paid $2000 per month, calculate the total amount of money Jaime pays to all the programmers per month.

parts.text: Craig and his brother take turns spelling out the longest letter words they know and counting the number of the letters in those words.
After ten rounds, Craig has spelled out 1/5 of one hundred words with 1.5 times of ten letters each.
If Craig's brother has spelled words with a total count of letters 50 more than Craig, calculate the total number of letters in the words they've spelled after the ten rounds.

parts.text: Conor resides close to a seaside area and enjoys spending his daily leisure time there.
During a specific week, he observed 50 individuals at the seaside on the initial day.
The following day, the count of people increased by 20 compared to the first day, and on the third day, the total count of individuals was twice as many as the second day.
If for the remaining days of the week Conor noticed an average of 60 people per day, determine the cumulative number of people Conor encountered at the seaside throughout that week.
